result.summary: The shipped application is real and ran remotely: all six browser images are genuine captures of the changed app at the temporary Worker origin https://deos-tmp-fd06b452d4155750a21db179.skundu.workers.dev/, the code in candidate/src/worker.ts genuinely uses env.DB (D1) and env.BODIES (R2) with ASSETS.fetch fallback, and candidate/src/web/app.js renders titles and bodies through textContent only. Nothing looks like a fixture screenshot, a faked service state or a fabricated receipt, and the checks transcript shows a real build and a real node verification run against the deployed environment. However, the saved plan's seven scenarios are only partly evidenced, and three gaps touch approved requirements directly. (1) Scenario 1 has no evidence at all: no publish_environment receipt, no migration output, no empty D1/R2 readback and no empty-shelf screenshot, so the "one D1 + one R2 binding, no login, one desktop screen from empty state" claim (spec:102, spec:56) rests on captions only. (2) Scenario 3, the mandatory fresh-browser-context proof the human explicitly asked for on 2026-09-17 16:57 ("use the preferred adjacent fresh-browser scenario against unchanged cloud data"), is backed by an image whose content hash (ce40231ac0d97915449988764d9d832125b3220e833b381296768f083e4dd281) is byte-identical to the scenario 2 post-delete image, and no GET /api/snippets transcript for that load was saved; nothing in the gallery distinguishes a new context from the already-open page, so spec:71's fresh-context scenario is not demonstrated. (3) Scenario 6 has no evidence and the final storage check lists only Greeting and Markup sample (no Alpha/Beta), so the "Report failed actions" requirement (spec:87) is shown by unit tests only, and tests are not application demonstrations. Scenario 4 shows only the blank-title rejection, not the whitespace-only-text rejection required by spec:16's second scenario, and no before/after D1+R2 comparison proving a rejected save wrote nothing. Scenario 7 storage proof is a prose summary printed by /deos/output/requests/verify-final-storage.mjs (a script not in the frozen sources) with no raw snippet ids, object keys or tombstone rows, no final-list screenshot, and no recorded removal of the temporary resources. Scenarios 2 and 5 pass on their own evidence. Fix the missing captures and readbacks; no requirement is weakened and no new requirement is added.
